issues.description: Inconsistent return type for fix_fix2float across artifacts: the tests header declares/defines fix_fix2float to return double, while the example_program implementation and its header use float. This creates a cross-artifact type mismatch (declaration/definition mismatch) that can produce undefined behaviour, linker/ABI problems or confusing type disagreements for students when they compile/run the tests and example program together.
issues.suggested_fix: Make the return type for fix_fix2float consistent across all headers and implementations. Either (A) change the tests header (tests/src/math_fix.h) to declare/define fix_fix2float returning float, matching example_program/src/math_fix.c and example_program/src/math_fix.h; or (B) change example_program/src/math_fix.c and example_program/src/math_fix.h to use double if higher precision is desired. Also avoid duplicate conflicting definitions across headers/source files (prefer a single implementation and matching prototypes in headers) to prevent ODR/ABI issues.
